title: Physarum polycephalum time-lapse imaging: 24 dish series from four six-dish experiments (OME-Zarr)

measurements.tile_selection: Tile center within fixed circle cx608 cy608 r504, publisher frame-zero circle; not organism segmentation.
measurements.coordinate_system: x=(gx+.5)/64, y=1-(gy+.5)/64; source images remain in original orientation
measurements.r_g_b: Native per-tile RGB means divided by255
measurements.texture: Mean absolute neighboring per-pixel luma differences, concatenating both axes
measurements.change: Mean absolute native RGB difference from same pixel rectangle in frame zero divided by255
measurements.seconds: Publisher timestamp nanoseconds minus frame-zero timestamp, divided by1e9

limitations: Twelve sampled native RGB crops from experiment001 dish0; no complete temporal reconstruction.
Publisher support masking is already in native images; no recoloring, downsampling, registration or flip applied to stored PNGs.
Measurements describe scan appearance and may reflect lighting, food, dish and organism; luma/texture/change are not validated biological coverage or tissue mass.
Fixed publisher frame-zero circle is unreviewed; center-based tile selection is not a verified physical dish boundary.
Flatbed scanner view is mirrored relative to an above-dish view.
Whole-archive MD5/SHA256 and source full-scan PNG hashes are publisher values, unverified by partial extraction.
Complete small-entry ZIP CRC32 and image shard-index CRC32C verified; image shard ZIP CRC32 unavailable without fetching all frames.
No food coordinates, inoculum, segmentation, network or scientific conclusions inferred.
Use publisher-corrected300dpi calibration if physical units are needed; stored OME scale is superseded.
